https://example.test/reports/logistics.title: Quarterly logistics report
https://example.test/reports/logistics.text:
# Quarterly logistics report

Freight volumes rose through the quarter as warehouse teams cleared the backlog. The report tracks tonnage, dwell time and outbound trailers.

Dwell time improved once the yard was resurfaced.

https://example.test/notes/throughput.title: Warehouse throughput notes
https://example.test/notes/throughput.text:
# Warehouse throughput notes

Throughput notes describe how many containers left the yard each week. The crew logs every gate move and reconciles it against the manifest.

Night shifts moved the most trailers.

https://docs.example.test/harbour/schedu.title: Harbour scheduling handbook
https://docs.example.test/harbour/schedu.text:
# Harbour scheduling handbook

Berth scheduling assigns cranes and pilots to arriving vessels. A slot is held until the pilot reports the vessel under control.

Weather delays are logged against the slot.

https://docs.example.test/harbour/capaci.title: Port capacity primer
https://docs.example.test/harbour/capaci.text:
# Port capacity primer

Port capacity is measured in moves per hour and berth occupancy. Planners compare those figures with the forecast for the season.

Occupancy above eighty percent slows turnaround.

https://news.example.test/rail/outlook.title: Rail freight outlook
https://news.example.test/rail/outlook.text:
# Rail freight outlook

Rail operators expect steady demand for bulk cargo next season. Network upgrades should shorten the run to the inland terminal.

Fuel prices remain the main risk.

https://news.example.test/containers/bac.text:
# Container backlog report

Container backlogs eased after the terminal added a second gate. Average queue time fell by a third within a month.

The gate runs two shifts.

# Glossary of shipping terms

A glossary of shipping terms explains demurrage, drayage and stowage. Each entry lists the invoice line where the charge appears.

Editors add a new term every month.

# Customs paperwork guide

Customs paperwork covers declarations, invoices and certificates of origin. A missing certificate holds the shipment at the border.

Brokers file the declaration electronically.
